text:
anna_product: quick sync — PLG customers are pushing for a new mid-tier with a 50% higher token cap and a 'priority burst' add-on. want to align on launch guardrails before we commit.
miguel_pm: can you share the concrete asks? numbers matter for ops and pricing math.
anna_product: they want baseline 5M tokens/month, add-on gives +2M burst for short periods. also SLA of 99.9 for dedicated customers in that tier.
kevin_sales: customer A asked for that exact thing; willing to sign 12mo with 30% discount if we include priority bursts and dedicated routing during peak windows.
sara_research: priority burst implies reserving capacity or preemptible fifo — we need clear routing policy. also need perf safety checks for latency regression.
liz_ops: if we do reserved capacity for bursts we have to update autoscaler and billing meter. that is nontrivial but doable in 2 sprints.
miguel_pm: launch criteria proposal: 1) latency SLO validated on representative workloads, 2) rollout plan with canary to 10% customers, 3) billing and metering QA, 4) contract language for burst usage and fair use.
kevin_sales: contract needs explicit overage and termination clauses. customer will push back on 'fair use' — they want guaranteed burst windows.
contract_bot: FYI: recommended clause template: "Priority Burst: Customer may request burst capacity up to X tokens per minute; provider reserves right to throttle under infrastructure emergencies. Overage fees apply as specified." :warning:
sara_research: also add an evaluation harness to detect quality regressions when bursts route to quantized variants. we saw subtle drift in reranking tests last quarter.
anna_product: tradeoffs: higher token caps vs. unit economics. we should model expected revenue and incremental infra cost for bursts. can someone run a quick take?
liz_ops: rough: dedicated burst pools cost ~0.25$/1k tokens at peak — need conversion to monthly for forecast. I'll drop a small sheet.
miguel_pm: prioritization: do we ship mid-tier + burst as one initiative or stagger? my vote: stagger. Tier first with soft limits, then burst as an add-on once billing+ops ready.
kevin_sales: staggered is ok but sales will need provisional term sheet for customers wanting immediate bursts.
sara_research: if staged, make sure the SDK/console flags are ready to flip to enable burst for specific accounts.
anna_product: agreed. action items: @liz_ops run cost forecast and infra effort (ETA 3 days). @sara_research write regression harness template (ETA end of week). @contract_bot prepare provisional clause variants. @kevin_sales collect 2 customer term-sheet asks. i'll own prioritization doc and canary plan.
kevin_sales: I can get customer A and B to review term sheet draft this week.
liz_ops: starting cost calc now.
contract_bot: Provisional clauses created and uploaded to /legal/drafts (placeholder link) :link: 
miguel_pm: we'll review in planning sync Friday and decide whether to schedule burst work in next milestone or the subsequent one. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
